decisions.reason: The area elastic sports floor builds on the firm's established wood-surface know-how and production, and with industry turnover growing there is no performance shortfall forcing problemistic search, so slack allows the firm to carry it.
The mobile arena floor serves an established sports segment with low added cost, and without evidence of underperformance against aspirations management has little reason to withdraw it.
This second mobile arena system overlaps with Product B and is the more likely candidate for portfolio consolidation, but in a growing market slack lets the firm keep both for now.
The chevron parquet fits the firm's trend-led residential strategy closely and was featured on the home page, so it likely meets or exceeds aspiration levels.
The squash court finish is a small niche, but it costs little to maintain and complements the sports flooring range, so absent a clear shortfall it stays.
The oak skirting is a low-cost accessory that supports sales of the sports floor systems, so dropping it would release few resources.
